The '''Clockwatcher''' was a [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]] produced by [[MicroThrust Processors]]. Each watch maintained [[Galactic Standard Time|Standard Galactic time]] as well as up to fifty local time-keeping methods and time zones. Optional extras for the chronometer included a [[temperature sensor]], a [[gravity sensor]], an [[atmosphere sensor]], and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].
